categories.name: Corrugated Boxes & Pads
categories.description: Heavy-duty 32 ECT and double-wall corrugated shipping boxes, garment boxes, pads, Gaylord containers, and bin boxes.

categories.name: Stretch Wrap & Dispensers
categories.description: Hand-length, machine-length, and mini stretch films along with pallet wrapping equipment and dispensers.

categories.name: Poly Bags & Tubing
categories.description: Clear lay-flat, reclosable, resealable warning bags, continuous poly tubing, heat sealers, and retail bags.

categories.name: Mailers & Shipping Envelopes
categories.description: Self-seal poly mailers, white/colored/kraft bubble mailers, insulated thermal mailers, and packing list envelopes.

categories.name: Packaging Tape & Dispensers
categories.description: Carton sealing tape, reinforced water-activated kraft tape, handheld dispensers, and automated case sealers.

categories.name: Bubble, Foam & Cushioning
categories.description: Perforated bubble rolls, bubble out bags, polyethylene foam rolls & sheets, kraft paper rolls, and biodegradable loose fill.

categories.name: Strapping, Seals & Buckles
categories.description: Industrial steel, PET polyester, and polypropylene strapping coils, seals, wire/plastic buckles, tools, kits, and baling wire.

categories.name: Shipping & Thermal Labels
categories.description: Direct thermal roll and fanfold shipping labels, laser/inkjet sheet labels, and commercial barcode printers.

categories.name: Edge Protectors & Dunnage
categories.description: Laminated fiberboard corner edge protectors, steel stake pocket protectors, and AAR-approved inflatable dunnage bags.

products.name: Steel Strapping - Standard Duty
products.description: Cold-rolled standard duty steel strapping engineered for unitizing, palletizing, and general commercial freight bundling. Available in oscillated wound coils (OSC).

products.name: Steel Strapping - High Tensile
products.description: Heat-treated high tensile steel strapping built for heavy-duty industrial loads, lumber, steel coils, and rail/truck securement. Offered in OSC and Ribbon Wound (RBW) coils.

products.name: Steel Strapping - Zinc Coated
products.description: Zinc-enriched corrosion-resistant steel strapping designed for outdoor storage, humid warehouses, and marine export freight.

products.name: Steel Strapping - Punched
products.description: Pre-punched industrial steel strapping engineered for specialized bracing, hanging, and indexed tie-down applications.

products.name: Steel Strapping - Mini Coils (52 Coils/Skid)
products.description: Portable 300 ft dispenser box steel strapping mini coils. Sold in skid quantities only (52 coils per skid).

products.name: PolyPropylene Embossed Strapping - Machine Grade (8" ID x 6" Face)
products.description: Machine grade embossed polypropylene strapping on 8" ID x 6" face core. 28 coils per pallet, packed 1 coil per box.

products.name: PolyPropylene Embossed Strapping - Machine Grade (8" ID x 8" Face)
products.description: High-speed automatic machine grade embossed polypropylene strapping on 8" ID x 8" face core. 24 coils per pallet, 1 coil per box.

products.name: PolyPropylene Embossed Strapping - Machine Grade (9" ID x 8" Face)
products.description: Automatic machine grade embossed polypropylene strapping on 9" ID x 8" face core. 24 coils per pallet, 1 coil per box.

products.name: PolyPropylene Embossed Strapping - Machine Grade (16" ID x 6" Face Bulk)
products.description: Bulk pack machine grade polypropylene strapping on 16" ID x 6" face core, including low elongation options. 28 coils per pallet.

products.name: PolyPropylene Embossed Strapping - Machine Grade (16" ID x 8" Face Bulk)
products.description: Low elongation machine grade polypropylene strapping on 16" ID x 8" face core. Bulk pack, 24 coils per pallet.

products.name: PolyPropylene Embossed Strapping - Hand Grade (16" ID x 6" Face)
products.description: Heavy-duty hand grade embossed polypropylene strapping on 16" ID x 6" face core. 28 coils per pallet, 1 coil per box.

products.name: Premium Machine Grade AAR PET Polyester Strap
products.description: AAR-approved high-strength polyester (PET) machine grade strapping in Smooth/Waxed, Smooth/Non-Waxed, Embossed/Waxed, and Embossed/Non-Waxed finishes for heavy palletization and rail securement.

products.name: Standard Machine Grade PET Polyester Strap
products.description: Standard machine grade PET polyester strapping for automated strapping machines, carton bundling, and brick/lumber applications.

products.name: Steel Strapping Seals - Open (Snap-On)
products.description: Open snap-on steel seals for fast placement over pre-tensioned steel strapping in Standard Duty and Heavy Duty gauges.

products.name: Steel Strapping Seals - Push On (Closed)
products.description: Closed push-type steel seals engineered for round, irregular, or narrow surface packages where push-type tensioners are used.

products.name: Steel Strapping Seals - Thread On (Heavy Duty)
products.description: Extra heavy duty 2" thread-on closed steel seal for high-tension wide steel strapping.

products.name: Steel Strapping Magazine Seals
products.description: Collated magazine-fed steel seals for high-speed pneumatic and manual combination strapping tools.

products.name: Steel Stake Pocket Edge Protectors
products.description: Heavy-gauge steel 2" x 6" stake pocket corner/edge protector designed to shield strapping and cargo from sharp load edges.

products.name: Steel Intersection Strapping Seals
products.description: Cross-tie intersection steel seal engineered to join perpendicular 1 1/4" steel straps securely.

products.name: Polypropylene Strapping Seals - Open
products.description: Galvanized open serrated seals built for manual crimping with polypropylene (PP) strapping.

products.name: Polyester Strapping Seals - Open
products.description: Heavy serrated galvanized open seals engineered for high-tension PET polyester strapping.

products.name: Polyester Strapping Seals - Snap On
products.description: Snap-on serrated polyester seals with interior grit gripping action for maximum joint efficiency.

products.name: Polyester Strapping Seals - Magazine
products.description: Collated magazine serrated seals for 5/8" PET polyester strapping combination tools.

products.name: Polyester Strapping Seals - Semi Open
products.description: Heavy-gauge semi-open 3/4" serrated seal engineered for high break-strength PET strapping.

products.name: Strapping Buckles - Wire & Plastic
products.description: Self-locking wire and plastic strapping buckles for hand-tensioned polypropylene and polyester strapping without sealers.
